text:
Maya: Morning triage — we're seeing a ~3x spike in new tickets vs yesterday (60 -> 180 last hour). Most are embedding timeouts for customer uploads.
triage-bot: Automated snapshot: open=182, new=64 in 1h, P1=2, labels=[embeddings, upload, timeout]
Priya: I'm on it. I've started a focused search for recent deploys to embedding-serving. No deploys in the last 6h, so maybe infra.
Alex: Quick check — can you paste the error logs for one of the timeouts? I want to see if it's an auth vs compute issue.
Priya: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T07:12:34Z ERROR embeddings_upload_handler timeout after 120s
trace: grpc deadline exceeded
backend: nvidia-gpu-7 region-us-west2
```
Maya: Thanks. Also noticed a bad macro that gives users the wrong retry steps. I'm going to propose a replacement — pinging @Jamie for copy check & @Liam for a quick code review if we need to change support tooling.
Jamie: can review copy in 15m :thumbsup:
Liam: FYI I can land a tiny change to the support helper script (1-line) today. Ping me when macro text is final.
Maya: Proposed macro update (replace "ask user to retry" with targeted guidance):
```
Macro: embeddings_timeout_upload
Message:
Hi — we're seeing timeouts for large file embeddings. Please try:
1) Reduce batch size to 64 or fewer items.
2) Retry with `?format=ndjson` (streaming uploads reduce memory overhead).
3) If issue persists, collect and paste the last 120s of logs (see https://redwood/docs/support/logs).
We're investigating on our side; we'll update here in <2h.
```
Priya: Looks good. I'll push that macro change and attach a KB link. Also will watch scaling alerts and circle back.
triage-bot: Alert: autoscaler triggered 3x scale in us-west2 07:14 — completed.
Maya: sweet. plan: Priya watches alerting, Liam + Alex on fail repro if it persists, Jamie lands copy. I'll update the macro and close the loop in 2h. Thanks team :raised_hands:
